The center of a 7 x 7 patch has the value 40. The patch is 200 where x or y is 4 or more, so the center sits at the inside corner of a bright L. 11 circle pixels in a row are brighter than 40 / 255 + 0.15, and none are darker. With n = 9 the segment test passes, and the score is 11 x (200 / 255 - 40 / 255 - 0.15) = 5.2520. With n = 12 the run is too short, so the score is 0.
